meta.title: Implement liveness analysis optimization
meta.body_summary: Add liveness analysis with dead code elimination and constant folding to the VM optimizer, updating golden IR outputs across many tests.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI Codex produced a compiler optimization with golden test updates; merged by author without external review. No performance benchmark, only correct behavior tests.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2466 changed lines across 104 files, this is a large change by absolute volume, but most of it is regenerated IR golden outputs (token updates). The core liveness analysis addition is ~600 lines in one new file. The PR merges a compiler optimization pass without external review, fitting a self-contained, fast merge scenario.

review_details.concern_detail: There are no formal reviews or comments on this PR; the PR was merged by the author without external review.
review_details.performance_claim: Add liveness analysis with dead code elimination and constant folding to reduce the size and improve efficiency of generated bytecode.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Compiler optimization like liveness analysis and dead code elimination is within the capability of code generation agents when integrated with existing testing infrastructure (golden file comparison). No review was required for merge, indicating low process friction.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Golden IR output files show the effect of optimization, and tests pass with `go test`. No benchmark or end-to-end timing comparison provided.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression issues observed; iterated on golden test outputs to match optimized IR.

core_change_summary.description: Added `runtime/vm/liveness.go` implementing liveness analysis and dead code elimination. Invoked optimizer per compiled function. Extended constant folding and branch pruning in the VM. Updated golden IR output files across many tests to reflect optimized code.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most changes outside liveness.go are regenerated golden files reflecting the effects of optimization on test expected outputs.
change_trajectory: First commit: added liveness.go and updated many IR golden files to reflect dead code elimination.
Subsequent commits: documented optimizer, fixed leetcode tests, ensured newlines, iterated on optimizer fixes and normalized golden outputs, fixed golden comparison logic.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with large commit adding liveness analysis and regenerating many golden files.
No external reviewers; author merged after ~3.5 hours and multiple fixup commits (tests, formatting, optimizer tweaks).
